name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
summary: At a small Alliance camp on the Webwinder Path, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks to win over Stonetalon’s night elves. The ambitious gnome scholar and tinker represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and aims to prove that artifice and alchemy can preserve their woodland realm. He also bears a fierce grudge against the Venture Company’s destructive operations.

sections.title: A Scientific Emissary
sections.body: In Stonetalon’s craggy passes, Gaxim Rustfizzle brings night elves a different way to defend the wilds. He represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and believes calculated mechanisms and chemical solutions can defend and restore Kalimdor’s wilderness as well as prayers to Elune. Alongside the sentinel Kaela Shadowspear, he camps on the Webwinder Path and works to convince his tall, reclusive allies that engineering can serve the living forest.

sections.title: Sabotaging the Saws
sections.body: The Venture Company’s clear-cutting and industrial greed scar nearby Windshear Crag, drawing much of Gaxim’s effort. He believes their crude goblin machinery deserves neither respect nor mercy, and coordinates covert operations and volatile chemical sabotage against their logging operations. Crippling the shredders and stealing their schematics are operations he coordinates, meant to show that gnomish intellect can defeat careless corporate plunder.

faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome scholar and inventor at an Alliance lookout on the Webwinder Path in the Stonetalon Mountains. He represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences.

faq.q: What is the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences?
faq.answer: The Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences is a gnomish academic society that blends arcane magic, alchemical mixtures and mechanical engineering. Gaxim represents its ideals abroad in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is Gaxim working with the night elves?
faq.answer: Gaxim wants to show the night elves that gnomish science and alchemy can protect and heal woodlands. He offers a modern Alliance answer to forest conservation alongside traditional druidism.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim hate the Venture Company?
faq.answer: Gaxim hates the Venture Company for ruthlessly clear-cutting Windshear Crag with crude machines and toxic pollution. He despises their reckless exploitation and turns volatile chemicals and sabotage against their operations.

faq.q: Who is camped with Gaxim on Webwinder Path?
faq.answer: Gaxim shares his small outpost on Webwinder Path with Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel watching the trails into Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Where can Gaxim Rustfizzle be found?
faq.answer: Gaxim is at a modest Alliance camp on the Webwinder Path, just southwest of Windshear Crag’s industrial logging pits in the Stonetalon Mountains.

angles.text: Gaxim carries gnomish academic pride into Kalimdor, showing its ancient cultures that gears and reagents can save a forest as well as nature magic.
Gaxim is a steadfast ally, actively defending the Ashenvale and Stonetalon borders from goblin industry.
Gaxim applies engineering in the field, designing covert operations and tactical devices specifically tuned to disrupt crude Venture Company machinery.
On the perilous Webwinder Path, Gaxim provides scouting, intelligence and sabotage missions to check aggressive industrial incursions in Stonetalon.
